answer: Attestation weight is reciprocal, so the score you give comes back to you: a panel that waves junk through raises the junk score it will be judged by, and one attempt to link two identities resets their shared history to zero. Because auditors rotate out of a pool every epoch, an operator cannot buy the same three judges twice and must keep the whole lagoon of accounts clean enough to survive a fresh draw, where the prism of one operator wearing many faces shows up as an onyx mark the first time two of them vote for each other.
